title: Turn on identifiers_only in people search or the row can't be read again
hypothesis: Full profiles from people search are fine to store in the row.
change: Ran Celsius at limit 2 with full profiles, then 5 people with identifiers_only=true.
result: Full profiles came to 49,826 chars, over the 20,000-char background read, and the row could never be read again. identifiers_only gave about 2,800 chars for 5 people, with name, title and URL intact.
next_decision: Default identifiers_only on; keep the row id from add-rows.
check: Any enrichment that returns nested profiles: estimate chars per row at the chosen limit against the 20,000 read cap before running it on a table.
scope: Clay people search column, background row reads, October 2026.
